job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities:

Develop, test, and maintain applications and backend services using Python.
Design and develop RESTful APIs and web services.
Write clean, scalable, reusable, and well-documented code.
Work with frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
Design, develop, and optimize database queries and data models.
Integrate applications with third-party APIs and external systems.
Perform unit testing, debugging, code reviews, and performance optimization.
Identify and resolve application defects and production issues.
Develop automation scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency.
Work with Git and follow version-control and software development best practices.
Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
Support CI/CD pipelines and application deployment processes.
Prepare technical documentation and maintain application specifications.
Stay updated with emerging Python technologies, libraries, frameworks, and development practices.

Required Skills:

6-10 years of experience in Python development.
Strong proficiency in Python programming and object-oriented programming concepts.
Hands-on experience with Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
Good knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and web services.
Strong experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
Knowledge of Git/GitHub/GitLab and software development workflows.
Experience with unit testing frameworks such as PyTest or unittest.
Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud platforms is an advantage.
Knowledge of Redis, Celery, Kafka, or microservices architecture is preferred.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
